coordinate_frame: GLB: three.js Y-up.  Canonical fish: length 1 along +X (head +X), dorsal +Y, Blender lateral +Y = three -Z; origin = the ORIGINAL scan bbox centre (both LODs share it, so swapping LODs never shifts the fish).  Scale an instance by its body length in metres.
three_notes: near and far reference the SAME external atlas <id>.jpg (relative uri): share one texture; texture.colorSpace = SRGBColorSpace, flipY = false (GLTFLoader does this)

materials are doubleSided (single-sheet fins in the scans) EXCEPT where species[].material.doubleSided is false (closed scans whose fin skins cross after decimation; the GLB flag already says so — a custom ShaderMaterial must copy it as side = FrontSide, else dark fin-underside flecks show through)

spec.reference_impl: tools/web_fishswim_ref.py deform() — numpy, checked against Blender's evaluated node group on a real scan per style at frames 1/37/121/200/241: max |diff| <= 7.2e-7 body lengths (float32 noise) for all 10 styles (checks/web/fishswim_ref_test.json)
spec.frame: Formulas use the Blender canonical fish frame: x along the body (head +x, x in -0.5..0.5), y lateral, z dorsal.  The GLB is three.js Y-up, so in the vertex shader use x = p.x, y = -p.z, z = p.y, deform, then write back p = (x', z', -y').  The model matrix (instance scale = body length in metres) is applied AFTER the deformation.
helpers: smoothstep(e0,e1,v): t = clamp((v-e0)/(e1-e0),0,1); t*t*(3-2t)   (Blender Map Range SMOOTHSTEP; also used with e0 > e1 = decreasing)
tau = mod(cycles * frame, loop_frames) / loop_frames      (frame 1..240; cycles is an INTEGER so frame 241 == frame 1)
ymax, zmax = species.rig_extents (max |y|, |z| of the original mesh; the rig measures the bbox of the deformed mesh, use the SAME value for both LODs)
wave(sv, lam, k=1, off=0) = sin(2*pi*(sv/lam - k*tau + phase + off))

bend(d(.), along, across):  d0 = d(s);  m = (d(s-H) - d(s+H)) / (2H);  c = 1/sqrt(1+m*m);  sn = m*c;  w = smoothstep(0.22, 0.10, |across|);  along' = along - w*across*sn;  across' = d0 + across*(1 - w*(1-c))

styles.rajiform_undulate: z += amp*ry*ry*smoothstep(0.72,0.50,s)*wave(s,wavelength);  d(sv) = amp*1.3*detail*e*e*wave(sv,0.9) with e = smoothstep(0.5,1.0,sv);  (x,y) = bend(d,x,y)  (both from the ORIGINAL x,y,z)
styles.hover_drift: d(sv) = amp*(0.3+0.7*sv)*wave(sv,wavelength);  (x,y) = bend(d,x,y);  rad = sqrt(y0*y0+z0*z0)/max(ymax,zmax);  y += 0.006*detail*rad*rad*wave(s,0.15,4);  rho = 0.05*detail*wave(0,1,1,0.25);  (y,z) = (y*cos(rho) - z*sin(rho), y*sin(rho) + z*cos(rho))
styles.benthic_rest: d(sv) = amp*smoothstep(0.55,1.0,sv)*wave(sv,wavelength);  (x,y) = bend(d,x,y);  gill = smoothstep(0.08,0.20,s)*smoothstep(0.45,0.30,s);  y += y0*0.025*detail*gill*wave(0,1);  fr = clamp((ry-0.45)/0.55,0,1);  z += 0.008*detail*fr*fr*wave(s,0.3,3)

spec.normals: the rig recomputes shading from the deformed mesh (custom normals cleared, all smooth).  In a vertex shader: rotate the normal about the dorsal axis by atan(m) for the bend styles, or finite-difference the deformation.

fishswim.variant_rule: library variant k: phase = k/6, cycles/amplitude per variant (library_variants); the final scene re-timed the schooling species (final_scene_variants)
